summary: BioVie Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 960,000 Class A common shares at $1.60 and 2,002,500 pre-funded warrants at $1.5999, grossing roughly $4.74 million. A concurrent private placement adds 2,962,500 common warrants at $1.70, exercisable in six months and expiring five years later. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners serves as exclusive placement agent for a 7.0% cash fee. The November 3, 2026 securities purchase agreement references a $1.73 last sale. This is a routine shelf takedown with no special-situation element; watch dilution, warrant overhang and Nasdaq compliance.
